```{r}
k <- 10

devtools::load_all()
library(tidyverse)

# pca
pm.ls <- load_cache("peakmatrix")
pm <- pm.ls[["matrix"]]
meta <- pm.ls[["metadata"]]
pca.scores <- vegan::scores(vegan::pca(pm), display = "sites", choices = 1:15, scaling = 1) %>% as.data.frame() 

# cc
cc.summary.ls <- reduce(c("cor_pearson", "manhattan", "cor_spearman"), .init = list(), .f = \(ls, dm){
    cc.summary <- pca.scores %>% 
        consensus_clustering(k = k, reps = 1000, dist_method = dm) %>%
        consensus_clustering_summarize(
            k = k, 
            themes = list(theme(
                axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                legend.position = "none"
            )))
    ls[[dm]] <- cc.summary
    return(ls)
})

# tsne
metadata <- meta %>% left_join(cc.summary.ls[["cor_pearson"]]$cl, by = "label")
tsne_plot <- function(
    mv.matrix,
    metadata,
    perplexity,
    dims = 2,
    seed = NULL
) {
    if (!is.null(seed)) {set.seed(seed)}
    tsne <- Rtsne::Rtsne(
        dims = dims,
        X = mv.matrix,
        theta = 0,
        max_iter = 5000,
        perplexity = perplexity
    )
    tsne_mtx <- tsne$Y %>% 
        as.data.frame() %>%
        `colnames<-`(paste0("TSNE", 1:dims)) %>%
        bind_cols(metadata)

    tsne_plot <- ggplot() +
        ggiraph::geom_point_interactive(
            data = tsne_mtx, 
            aes(x = TSNE1, y = TSNE2, color = cc_cluster, data_id = label, tooltip = label),
            size = 3,
            hover_nearest = T
        ) +
        labs(title = paste0("t-SNE perplexity = ", perplexity)) +
        scale_color_manual(values = rcartocolor::carto_pal(n = length(unique(tsne_mtx$cc_cluster)), name = "Bold")) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(
            aspect.ratio = 1,
            plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "Times New Roman", hjust = 0.5),
            axis.ticks.length = unit(-0.05, "in"),
            axis.text.y = element_text(margin=unit(c(0.3,0.3,0.3,0.3), "cm")),
            axis.text.x = element_text(margin=unit(c(0.3,0.3,0.3,0.3), "cm")),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
            plot.background = element_blank(),
            legend.background = element_blank(),
            panel.background = element_rect(color = NULL, fill = "white"),
            panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "transparent"),
            panel.grid = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
            legend.text = element_markdown(),
            legend.position = "none"
        )
    return(tsne_plot)
}
tsne_ggplot <- tsne_plot(pm, metadata, 5, seed = 43)

# spectra
maldi.meta <- load_cache("peakmatrix")$metadata

rs <- load_cache("rawSpectra.rich")
maldi_extract_ms <- function(rs){
    map_dfr(rs, \(s){
        if (length(maldi.meta[which(maldi.meta$maldi_id == MALDIquant::metaData(s)$maldi_id),]$label) == 0) {return(data.frame(NULL))}
        sp.df <- data.frame(x = s@mass, y = s@intensity, label = maldi.meta[which(maldi.meta$maldi_id == MALDIquant::metaData(s)$maldi_id),]$label)
        
        sp.df <- 
            sp.df %>% 
            mutate(mass_bin = cut(x, breaks = 1000, labels = FALSE)) %>% 
            group_by(mass_bin) %>%
            summarise(y = max(y), x = mean(x)) %>% 
            mutate(label = sp.df$label[[1]]) %>% 
            dplyr::select(-mass_bin)

        return(sp.df)
    })
}
rs.df <- maldi_extract_ms(rs)

library(ggiraph)

rs.plot <- rs.df %>% 
    ggplot() +
    geom_line_interactive(aes(x = x, y = y, data_id = label), color = "transparent") +
    theme_minimal()

rs.ip <- girafe(rs.plot, height_svg = 3)

as <- load_cache("averagedSpectra")
as.df <- maldi_extract_ms(as)

as.plot <- as.df %>% 
    ggplot() +
    geom_line_interactive(aes(x = x, y = y, data_id = label), color = "transparent") +
    theme_minimal()

as.ip <- girafe(as.plot, height_svg = 3)



# merge
layout <- "
1234
5566
"
combi <- 
    tsne_ggplot + cc.summary.ls$cor_pearson$heatmap + cc.summary.ls$manhattan$heatmap + cc.summary.ls$cor_spearman$heatmap + 
    rs.plot + as.plot +
    patchwork::plot_layout(design = layout, widths = c(2,3,3,3,5,5))


ip <- ggiraph::girafe(
    ggobj = combi,
    height_svg = 10, 
    width_svg = 18
)

htmltools::save_html(ip, "docs/logs/assets/1128/maldi_ds.html")
```
